observation: selectSemanticContext filled the bounded selection from ranked nodes before attempting import/test neighborhood expansion, so the neighborhood phase could be unreachable whenever maxFiles or maxBytes was exhausted.
change: Interleave each ranked node with its existing import/test neighbors so the already-declared neighborhood signal participates before unrelated lower-ranked files consume the budget. No new graph relation type or product architecture was introduced.
truth_boundary: Selection remains bounded by the already-observed semantic graph; files absent from the bounded manifest/seed context are still outside this graph and are not claimed to be recoverable by this change.
